title: Limit Uplift for Waiting FBN Warehouse-Loss Cases
content:
The limit uplift on a Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) warehouse-loss case is the long-wait uplift of 10 units for a case opened at least the long-wait 30 days before the handling date, the short-wait uplift of 5 units for a case opened at least the short-wait 14 days but fewer than 30 days before it, and no uplift for a case opened fewer than 14 days before it.

The age of the case is the number of days from the case's opening to the handling date.

## Ages and uplift (hypothetical cases)

| Days from opening to the handling date | Uplift |
|---|---|
| 13 | none |
| 14 | 5 units |
| 29 | 5 units |
| 30 | 10 units |
| 75 | 10 units |
